title: Every Time I Hire a Linguist, Inference Costs Go Down: On Linguistic Rules as Effective Prompt Compressors
abstract: arXiv:2607.25335v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prompt compression shortens LLM input to reduce inference cost, yet existing methods score token importance through LM forward passes. It remains questionable whether such nuanced, costly token selection is necessary. Compression requires identifying informative content, a problem that linguistic research has long addressed through cues that can be operationalized as deterministic rules. We therefore ask: can \textbf{linguistic rules alone} serve as effective prompt compressors, without LM-based scoring at compression time?   To address this, we conduct offline evolutionary search over lexical, syntactic, semantic, and discourse seeds to find competitive rule combinations. The resulting linguistic compressor requires no LM forward pass at deployment and uses only CPU-side processing for compression. translated_title: 每当我雇一位语言学家，推理成本就下降：论语言学规则作为高效提示压缩器
translated_abstract: 提示压缩通过缩短大语言模型（LLM）的输入来降低推理成本，然而现有方法都依赖语言模型前向传播来评估词元重要性。这种精细而昂贵的词元选择是否必要仍值得质疑。压缩需要识别有信息量的内容，而语言学研究早已通过可操作化为确定性规则的线索来解决这个问题。因此我们提出这样的问题：仅凭语言学规则能否作为有效的提示压缩器，而无需在压缩时进行基于语言模型的评分？为解答这一问题，我们对词汇、句法、语义和语篇层面的种子规则进行离线进化搜索，以找到具有竞争力的规则组合。由此得到的语言学压缩器在部署时无需任何语言模型前向传播，仅靠CPU端处理即可完成压缩。我们采用双路径评估协议来平衡压缩质量与重构保真度。在短文本、多文档等
tldr: 该论文提出仅用语言学规则（词汇、句法、语义、语篇）作为提示压缩器，通过离线进化搜索获得规则组合，部署时无需语言模型前向传播、仅需CPU端处理即可有效降低LLM推理成本。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that linguistic rules alone—discovered via offline evolutionary search over lexical, syntactic, semantic, and discourse seeds—can serve as effective prompt compressors, requiring no LM forward pass at deployment and only CPU-side processing to reduce inference costs.
